note: An internal reasoning model disproved the conjectured upper bound in Erdős’s 1946 unit distance problem with a stronger construction; the proof was checked by external mathematicians, with comment from Noga Alon and Tim Gowers. The same day Will Sawin posted an explicit lower bound (arXiv:2605.20579). The exact maximum remains open.
title: An OpenAI model has disproved a central conjecture in discrete geometry
